concepts.name: Adoption on July 4 and the signing that began on August 2

evidence.quote: The Continental Congress adopted the Declaration of Independence on July 4, 1776.
on August 2, 1776, delegates began signing it.

concepts.name: Drafting by the committee of five, printing, and the engrossed parchment copy

evidence.quote: Congress appointed on June 10 a committee of five to draft a statement of independence for the colonies
Jefferson drafted the statement between June 11 and 28
the approved Declaration was printed on July 5th
On July 19th, Congress ordered that the Declaration be engrossed on parchment

objectives: Order the drafting, adoption, printing and signing of the Declaration of Independence using the dates the source states
Explain why adoption on July 4 and the start of signing on August 2 are separate events
